title: Chapter 202 Digestion
content:
Chapter 202 Digestion

The arrival of the Qin army caused great panic to the whole South Korea. If it weren't for the 200,000 elite imperial army stationed beside them, they would have surrendered the whole country in panic!

However, the Qin army on the opposite side was also afraid of the 200,000 cavalry of the imperial country. When they came to Sanchuan County opposite South Korea, they did not dare to make big moves. Instead, they stationed on the spot, separated from the imperial army of South Korea. confront each other.

This is also a strategy of the Qin State. The imperial army is thousands of miles away from their homeland. Compared with the Qin State, it cannot be farther away.

And if relying on Yuguo's local transportation of grain and grass materials, it will definitely be a huge waste, and Yuguo will be dragged down in less than a month.

However, with the support of Han, Zhao, Wei, and other Shandong countries, their strength has been weakened by the war, and their treasury has long been empty. How can it compare to Qin, which has a full treasury and sufficient soldiers and food?

Just like the Battle of Changping, when Lian Po was the commander-in-chief of the Zhao army, Qin State and Zhao State fought for three years. In the previous two and a half years, there have been no major wars, but small fights.

The armies of Zhao State and Qin State are facing each other across the city and pass, consuming each other's food and national power, and the competition is who will collapse first.

As a result, the Zhao State, which was closer and less logistically stressed, could not sustain it one step ahead of Qin State. With Zhao Kuo's rise to power, the Institute suffered a disastrous defeat in the Battle of Changping.

Now, the situation is so similar to the original situation, neither side is sure to win the other side, so let's procrastinate and bet on which side Qin and Yu will collapse first!

A long time passed like this, and the world once again fell into peace after the transfer of the Qin army. This period lasted for half a year.

In the past six months, many things happened in the world, attracting everyone's attention.

Among them is the grand immigration strategy that the imperial country does not need land, but the population!

According to the pre-war agreement, half of the population of the land captured by the Alliance will be handed over to the Imperial Kingdom.

Among them, the strength of Chu State is too strong, almost not inferior to Yu State, and the sense of crisis for the Qin Dynasty is also the weakest. Naturally, he has the strength not to make this agreement, and will go his own way.

Moreover, Yuguo has nothing to do with Chuguo, because they are far away, and they might not be able to win the fight, so what can he do!

But the three countries of Han, Zhao, and Wei are different. They are the weakest. Although they annexed the four counties left by Qin this time, their strength has not expanded to the point where they can ignore the imperial state and the pressure of Qin.

They knew very well that if they stood in front of Qin Jun's pressure without the support of Yuguo, the meat they just swallowed would probably be quickly taken back by Qin Jun who reacted.

What's even more frightening is that the Qin army, who became angry from embarrassment, would directly attack their land that was not affected by the war situation, making their already weak strength even more unbearable.

So when faced with Yuguo's request, although the three countries were extremely annoyed, they still had to smile and slowly honor it.

Among them, Wei Guo, which you have been threatened by Yu Guo before, is the most active.

The total population of the two counties recovered by Wei Guoxin is about 800,000, and half of them will be handed over to Yu Guo. This time, he cut off a large piece of meat, as if it was placed on King Wei, which made his heart ache.

With 400,000 people, it is natural not to move at will. This requires a process.

Among them, where these people rest on the way, and who will prepare food and supplies to ensure that they can reach the north safely, it is necessary for Yuguo to wrestle with the three countries of Zhao and Wei and Yan.

In the first month, the 100,000 people in the early stage of Wei State began to mobilize.

Before the common people had time to happily return to the embrace of their homeland, they were forcibly pulled out by their Qiang family at night. They gathered one by one, tied their hands and feet with ropes, and rushed to the north under the guard of soldiers.

Immediately, the impression of Wei Guo in the hearts of the old people of these two counties dropped to the point where it was even worse than Qin Guo.

In the next five months, half a year, these 400,000 people, more or less intermittently, finally set foot on the land of Yuguo.

And Zhao Guo, took Taiyuan County and Yanmen County, and gained a population of 700,000. However, Zhao Wang was so stubborn that he did not agree to the agreement to hand over half of the population, only willing to give away 1/3.

But Zhong Yu thought about it, the territory of Zhao State was originally sparsely populated, not comparable to the Central Plains regions like South Korea Wei State, the population is rich, if it is too weakened, it may affect the balance between them, so he reluctantly agreed.

Zhao State is close to Yu State, and not only has its own channels for transporting population, but also has the help of Yu State, so the migration and transportation of population is much faster than that of Wei State.

The population of 230,000 promised by the Zhao State quickly set foot on the land of the Yu State. It took only three months before and after, and the efficiency was fully double that of the Wei State.

The population contributed by the two countries was all allocated to his vast territory by Yuguo, and within two or three months, they were all settled without any disturbance.

After all, Yuguo, which covers an area of tens of thousands of miles, is too big, and this small number of people is not enough for him to fit between his teeth.

And Zhao Guo, after sending away these people, transferred some soldiers and horses from the original territory of Zhao Guo from the remaining people, and reorganized an army of 300,000, and Zhao Guo's momentum was once again shaken.

As for Wei Guo, he lost 400,000 people, and he has 400,000 left, all of which can be used to mobilize troops.

Moreover, the territory of these two counties is richer than the mountainous land obtained by Zhao Guo, the Central Plains! It has been famous for its fertile land and rich population since ancient times.

With the resources of these two counties, Wei's confidence has greatly increased, and he directly formed his army of 400,000, which shocked all countries in the world.

However, the country of Yan did not reap any benefits in this battle. Instead, it rushed to South Korea from a long distance, and the 100,000 army joined the country's 200,000 people.

These people, together with the 50,000 reorganized by South Korea, have a total of 350,000 troops, which is about the same as the number opposite Qin, and the strength of the two is even closer.

Now that all the countries in the alliance have digested their own fruits, and Qin has made preparations for the next bigger war, the world will once again start to be in turmoil.

This time, Zhao Guo directly sent 250,000 troops, except for 50,000 left to maintain the rule of law and order in various places, and the rest were sent to Shangdang County, preparing to take down this shameful place that the rotten Zhao State felt ashamed of.

As for Wei Guo, this is sending 300,000 troops to attack Hanoi County, the original territory of South Korea.

He: By doing this, the main purpose is to take down Hanoi County, then attack Hedong County, and regain the territory of Wei State at its peak.

Don't forget that Hedong was the capital of Wei State from the beginning, but it was forced by Qin State and had to withdraw to the current Daliang.

At the same time, if Hanoi is captured, then the Wei State and the territories in the direction of Hedong can be joined together, and there is no need to worry about separating the two sides.
